remarks:
Welcome to 4896 Ashville Bay Road, a rare lakefront retreat on Chautauqua Lake offering over 141 feet of shoreline across five parcels, breathtaking water views, and the perfect blend of charm, comfort, and privacy. Tucked away at the end of a quiet road, this special property captures the essence of classic Chautauqua Lake living while offering space for gathering, relaxing, and creating lasting memories.

Start your day on the inviting covered porch overlooking the lake, or enjoy the panoramic views from the bright year-round sunporch, the perfect place for morning coffee, reading, or watching boats drift across the water. Inside, the cozy living room with a fireplace flows into a charming dining area, creating a warm and welcoming space for entertaining family and friends.

The main bedroom features an en-suite bathroom with a walk-in closet, plus two additional bedrooms and a full hallway bath, providing comfortable accommodations for guests. Above the garage is a spacious bunk room with its own full bathroom, which offers even more flexibility, making this home ideal for hosting lake weekends and summer gatherings.

The large kitchen offers great space and potential, ready for your personal touches to make it your own.

Enjoy the scenic walk down the staircase to the lake, or take the included mule (ATV), which comes with the property, for an easy ride to the shoreline, where you are greeted by the included dock. 

Just steps from the water sits a charming guest cottage with a living/sleeping area, kitchenette, and full bathroom, creating the perfect space for visitors, extended family, or a peaceful private retreat by the lake.

Additional highlights include an attached garage, an expansive adjacent lot for additional parking, lush landscaping, and being sold furnished, making it easy to begin enjoying lake life right away.

Whether you are searching for a year-round lakefront home, a Chautauqua Lake summer cottage, or a private family retreat with a guest house and expansive frontage, 4896 Ashville Bay Road offers a rare opportunity to experience the beauty, serenity, and lifestyle of true Chautauqua Lake waterfront living.
